entrypoints.output: two PHP files (src/Entity/{Name}.php, src/Provider/{Name}ServiceProvider.php) + direct composer.json read-modify-write
entrypoints.why: CRITICAL/exemplar case. writeFile() at lines 100-101 writes two files with its own is_dir()||mkdir() guard (no transaction, no journal). registerProvider() at lines 280-313 decodes composer.json, appends to extra.waaseyaa.providers in memory, and writes it back with no lock, no collision check against a concurrent editor, and no rollback if the two prior file writes already landed and this step fails. This is the entrypoint ADR D-9 forbids after migration and D-6 gives a typed registration-effect design for. After migration it publishes one seeded non-root generation unit (D-2) and requires an initialized site (D-7 rule 6).
